research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Qualys is researching methods and systems for asset risk determination and utilization for threat mitigation, as well as attack path and graph creation based on user and system profiling. Their work includes domain-specific language approaches for defending against threat actors, simulating adversarial operations, and generating attack kill chains for threat analysis. Additional focus areas are remote security assessment, system vulnerability determination, API security testing, and security event modeling for threat detection.

overview_description.description:
The Qualys Cloud Platform and integrated suite of solutions helps businesses simplify security operations and lower the cost of compliance by delivering critical security intelligence on demand and automating the full spectrum of auditing, compliance and protection for IT systems and web applications.

Used by more than 7,700 customers in over 100 countries, including a majority of each of the Forbes Global 100 and Fortune 100, the Qualys Cloud Platform performs more than 1 billion IP scans/audits a year resulting in over 400 billion security events.

Founded in 1999, Qualys has established strategic partnerships with leading managed service providers and consulting organizations including BT, Dell SecureWorks, Fujitsu, IBM, NTT, Symantec, Verizon, and Wipro. The company is also a founding member of the Cloud Security Alliance (CSA).

The Qualys Cloud Platform and its integrated suite of security and compliance applications provides organizations of all sizes with a global view of their security and compliance solutions, while drastically reducing their total cost of ownership. Qualys solutions include: continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, policy compliance, pci compliance, questionnaire service, web application scanning, web application firewall, malware detection and SECURE Seal for security testing of web sites.

about_short_description.short_description: Qualys is the pioneer and leading provider of information security and compliance cloud solutions.

product.name: Enterprise TruRisk Platform
product.description: A cloud-based cybersecurity and compliance platform that unifies asset visibility, vulnerability management, threat protection, cloud security, application security, and compliance workflows.

product.name: VMDR (Vulnerability Management, Detection and Response)
product.description: A vulnerability management service that discovers assets, identifies vulnerabilities, prioritizes risks, and supports remediation across on-premises, cloud, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

product.name: CyberSecurity Asset Management (CSAM)
product.description: An asset management solution that maintains an inventory of hardware, software, cloud resources, and technology lifecycle risks, including end-of-life and end-of-support exposure.

product.name: TotalCloud
product.description: A cloud security service for discovering and assessing cloud assets, configurations, vulnerabilities, identities, and compliance risks across multi-cloud environments.

product.name: TotalAppSec
product.description: An application security offering that combines web application scanning, web malware detection, application inventory, and related controls for identifying and managing software risk.

product.name: Web Application Scanning (WAS)
product.description: A cloud-based web application scanning service that tests websites and web applications for vulnerabilities and supports security assessment throughout the application lifecycle.
